summary: Sow Good Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a share purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Uranex Tanzania Limited and Magnis Technologies (Tanzania) Limited, holders of the Nachu Graphite Project in Tanzania, from Ryzon Materials Limited and other sellers. The deal values the project at AUD 150M (~USD 107M), to be paid entirely in stock: ~334.1M shares (pre-reverse-split) based on a 10-day VWAP of USD 0.3209 and an AUD/USD exchange rate of 0.7149, equating to ~22.3M post-15-to-1 reverse split. The board has not disclosed a recommendation or advisor. Net debt adjustments and potential capital gains tax withholdings reduce consideration. Escrow of 10% supports indemnification via CVRs. The deal is structured as a stock-for-stock acquisition; close timing is unspecified. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory milestones; risk-arb centers on stock-price volatility given all-stock consideration.
